nodes.label: Session-based Permission System (RBAC)
nodes.rationale: Custom session-cached permission model chosen instead of Laravel Policies/Gates/Spatie to support three dimensions (permissions JSON, level, only_creator) not natively modeled by those packages.

nodes.label: Permission Caching (permissions_version)
nodes.rationale: permissions_version hash compared each request to invalidate/rebuild the session-cached permission matrix only when role/permission assignments actually change, avoiding recompute on every request.

nodes.label: Item & ItemVariant relation & usage note
nodes.rationale: Deliberate split: stock_ledger_entries.item_id points to items (master level, valuation) while stocks.item_variant_id points to item_variants (per-variant position); all transactional document line items reference ItemVariant (SKU) rather than Item master to allow per-SKU stock/pricing.

nodes.label: Payment Entry FIFO allocation to Payment Schedules
nodes.rationale: paid_amount is allocated FIFO by due_date across payment schedules so the oldest obligations are settled first, mirroring real-world payment application practice and keeping outstanding_amount accurate per schedule.
nodes.norm_label: payment entry fifo allocation to payment schedules

nodes.label: Valuation FIFO (stock_queue)
nodes.rationale: FIFO valuation chosen so cost of goods reflects the order stock was actually acquired; stock_queue JSON tracks {qty, rate} entries consumed head-first on stock-out, giving weighted-average accuracy without a separate ledger table.

nodes.label: Purchase Dual Flow (receive-first / bill-first)
nodes.rationale: PO tracks received_quantity and billed_quantity as separate columns so receipt and invoicing are independent, supporting both receive-first and bill-first business scenarios without extra document types.

nodes.label: Sales Dual Flow (SO->DN->SI or SO->SI->DN)
nodes.rationale: SO items keep delivered_quantity/undelivered_quantity separate from billed_quantity/unbilled_quantity so delivery and billing can happen in either order — supports deliver-first and bill-first (advance payment) business models.

nodes.label: WO does not touch stock/GL directly
nodes.rationale: WorkOrderService::submit() only generates code and checks approval; stock/accounting effects are deferred to spawned SO/IO/DN/SI documents, keeping WO a pure orchestration/tracking document.
nodes.norm_label: wo does not touch stock/gl directly

nodes.label: migration_mappings table (old_id -> new_ulid)
nodes.rationale: Legacy PKs are auto-increment integers while the new system uses ULIDs; migration_mappings records old_id->new_ulid per table so child records migrated later can resolve parent foreign keys without breaking relations.

nodes.label: migration_checkpoints resume mechanism
nodes.rationale: processChunkedWithCheckpoint() persists the last successful chunk key per migrator+scope so a mid-run failure can be resumed without reprocessing from scratch, important for large legacy datasets.

nodes.label: DataTable trait created hook (buffer auto-attach)
nodes.rationale: Hooking into the shared DataTable trait's created event lets buffered tags/files auto-attach to any newly created model without modifying every controller's store() method, chosen over per-controller changes to minimize surface area and regression risk.

nodes.label: Design decision: local buffer over server-side draft record
nodes.rationale: Rejected creating a server-side draft record before the form is submitted (adds complexity/orphan-record risk); chose local form-state buffering of tags/files, attached to the real record only after creation via the DataTable created hook.

nodes.rationale: Chose an in-flow grid-column sidebar using shadcn Sidebar collapsible="none" so it pushes/narrows the form within the dialog rather than overlaying it, avoiding z-index/overlay conflicts inside an AlertDialog.

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Development Workflow
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes tasks that need upfront spec docs (new features, architecture changes, 4+ file changes, complex bugs) from tasks to do directly (simple fixes, minor refactors), to avoid over-planning small work while forcing planning for risky/large work.

nodes.label: Git Worktree Freshness Rule
nodes.rationale: Must git fetch/pull the active branch before creating a worktree; otherwise the worktree is based on a stale commit, causing rejected non-fast-forward pushes and heavy rebase conflicts.

nodes.label: Bash-compatible Terminal Shell Rule
nodes.rationale: All terminal commands must use Git Bash (C:/Program Files/Git/usr/bin/bash.exe) instead of PowerShell/cmd, using POSIX commands and forward-slash paths for consistency.

nodes.label: Pint Formatting Rule
nodes.rationale: Run vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent after modifying PHP files (not --test) to auto-fix style so code matches project conventions.

nodes.label: PHPUnit Test Enforcement
nodes.rationale: All tests must be PHPUnit classes (convert Pest to PHPUnit); every change must be programmatically tested; never remove tests without approval.
